strings.enableglobalratelimit_desc: Limit the number of requests that the OpenAI API provider can receive across the entire site every hour.

strings.extraparams_help:
Extra parameters can be configured here. We support JSON format. For example: 
{
    "temperature": 0.5,
    "max_tokens": 100
}
strings.globalratelimit_desc: The number of site-wide requests allowed per hour.
strings.orgid_desc: Get an OpenAI organization ID from your OpenAI Platform account.
strings.orgid_help: Get your OpenAI organization ID from your OpenAI account.
strings.privacy:metadata: The OpenAI API provider plugin does not store any personal data.
strings.privacy:metadata:aiprovider_openai:exter: This information is sent to the OpenAI API in order for a response to be generated. Your OpenAI account settings may change how OpenAI stores and retains this data. No user data is explicitly sent to OpenAI or stored in Moodle LMS by this plugin.
strings.privacy:metadata:aiprovider_openai:model: The model used to generate the response.
strings.privacy:metadata:aiprovider_openai:numbe: When generating images the number of images used in the response.
strings.privacy:metadata:aiprovider_openai:promp: The user entered text prompt used to generate the response.
strings.privacy:metadata:aiprovider_openai:respo: The format of the response. When generating images.
strings.settings_frequency_penalty_help: The frequency penalty adjusts how often words are repeated. The higher the penalty, the less repetitions in the generated text.
strings.settings_help: Adjust the settings below to customise how requests are sent to OpenAI.
strings.settings_max_tokens_help: The maximum number of tokens used in the generated text.
strings.settings_presence_penalty_help: The presence penalty encourages the model to use new words by increasing the likelihood of choosing words it hasn't used before. A higher value makes the generated text more diverse, while a lower value allows more repetition.
strings.settings_top_p_help: top_p (nucleus sampling) determines how many possible words to consider. A high value (e.g. 0.9) means the model looks at more words, which makes the generated text more diverse.
strings.userratelimit: Maximum number of requests per user
strings.userratelimit_desc: The number of requests allowed per hour, per user.
